build.title: Tab group asset + per-asset appearance tokens (Fable rebuild)

said.text: Fable rebuild of the Opus build appearance-asset-tokens (branch claude/project-thread-g27t3y). Start by removing/replacing the Opus version.

steps.text: Review the Opus build: tab-group asset, customize engine (customize.json, icon-sets.json), settings cards; list what to keep/replace
Engine: fixture spec/fixtures/customize.json generated by gen-fixtures + replayed by check-customize; per-asset scoping of tokens (data-fx-asset ids) instead of active-only
Kotlin twins: TabGroup style + CustomizeEngine in the kernel (when Android hold lifts) or PORTING.md gap
Icon sets: real per-set glyph variants where stroke transforms fall short; preview grid in settings
Settings UI: per-token reset, search over tokens, copy settings between assets; differences report + LOG.md + shots
